newsitem.title: UK: EBRD lends $50 million to Russia's Chernogorneft.
newsitem.headline: EBRD lends $50 million to Russia's Chernogorneft.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said on Friday it was lending $50 million to Russian oil company Chernogorneft OAO.
The money will be used to finance a drilling programme, replace corroded pipes and recultivate contaminated areas, it said.

"The EBRD's loan is significant as Chernogorneft is the first oil company in Russia to have a Western reserve audit and financial statements audited in accordance with international accounting standards," EBRD first vice president Ron Freeman said.

Chernogorneft, which last year produced 41 million barrels of oil and is a subsidiary of Russian oil company Sidanco, said the loan would help it boost production at the Samotlor oil field in western Siberia. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7770 (fax +44 171 583 7239)
